kinds.label: Multirotor
kinds.summary: A multirotor: the controller works in fractions of full thrust and torque, so the airframe enters only through the thrust it needs to hover.

params.label: Hover thrust
params.note: Collective that holds the vehicle up, as a fraction of full thrust; the controller starts from it each run and learns the rest in flight.
params.source: PX4@af2e7b4311 src/modules/mc_pos_control/multicopter_position_control_params.yaml:14 MPC_THR_HOVER default 0.5 (ArduPilot MOT_THST_HOVER 0.35, AP_MotorsMulticopter.h:10, cannot lift a vehicle that hovers above 0.52: the velocity loop adds at most 2 + 2.8 m/s^2)

kinds.label: Rocket
kinds.summary: A single-stage rocket with an air brake: no motors to command, the brake deployment only.

kinds.label: madflight FC3
kinds.summary: Noise the filters assume for the FC3's LSM6DSV IMU, BMP580 barometer, MMC5603NJ magnetometer and an M10-class GNSS, the Earth field and gravity at the origin, and the stillness test of the alignment.

params.label: Accel noise
params.note: White noise per IMU sample (1σ) the filters assume.
params.source: eskf.hpp:22 An 60 ug/sqrt(Hz) (high-performance) * sqrt(500 Hz) = 1.342 mg (LSM6DSV DS13476 p.10 Table 2)

params.label: Accel bias walk
params.note: Random walk of the accelerometer bias.
params.source: eskf.hpp:24 the datasheet gives no bias instability; the fsw.ts preset

params.label: Gyro noise
params.note: White noise per IMU sample (1σ) the filters assume.
params.source: eskf.hpp:23 Rn 2.8 mdps/sqrt(Hz) * sqrt(500 Hz) = 0.0626 dps (LSM6DSV DS13476 p.10 Table 2)

params.label: Gyro bias walk
params.note: Random walk of the gyro bias.
params.source: eskf.hpp:25 the datasheet gives no bias instability; the fsw.ts preset

params.label: GNSS position noise
params.note: Horizontal, per axis, per fix (1σ).
params.source: eskf.hpp:32 ASSUMED u-blox M10 class (the FC3's receiver is an unspecified external module)

params.label: GNSS altitude noise
params.note: Vertical, per fix (1σ).

params.label: GNSS velocity noise
params.note: Per axis, per fix (1σ).

params.label: Heading noise

params.label: Earth field east

params.source: eskf.hpp:50 the Earth field (NED, microtesla) at the world origin

params.label: Earth field down

params.label: Gravity
params.note: Gravity the controller and estimators assume; a mismatch with the world reads as an acceleration.

params.label: Alignment window
params.note: Unbroken stillness averaged before the filter starts.
params.source: eskf.hpp:56 IMU, magnetometer and barometer samples are averaged over align_window_s of unbroken stillness

params.label: Still: gravity error
params.note: Largest | |f| - g | of a still sample.
params.source: eskf.hpp:57 3 sigma per axis of the 12 mg turn-on bias, plus noise

params.label: Still: rotation rate
params.note: Largest |w| of a still sample.
params.source: eskf.hpp:58 3 sigma per axis of the 1 dps turn-on bias, plus noise

params.label: Still: accel spread
params.note: Largest distance of f from the window's mean.

params.label: Still: gyro spread

params.source: eskf.hpp:60 6 per-sample sigmas (norm of three axes)

kinds.label: ESKF
kinds.summary: 15-state error-state Kalman filter (Solà 2017): position, velocity, attitude, accelerometer and gyro biases.

params.label: Position prior
params.note: Position 1σ at alignment, per axis.

params.label: Velocity prior
params.note: Velocity 1σ at alignment, per axis.

params.label: Attitude prior
params.note: Attitude 1σ at alignment, per axis.
params.source: eskf.hpp:45 12 mg / g = 0.012 rad of tilt, 1.98 times that on the tilt-compensated heading

params.label: Accel bias prior
params.note: Accelerometer bias 1σ at alignment, per axis.
params.source: eskf.hpp:46 LSM6DSV typical zero-g level, 12 mg (p.10 Table 2)

kinds.label: EKF
kinds.summary: 15-state extended Kalman filter on the full state; the same process noise, priors and measurements as the ESKF.

params.label: Position prior
params.note: Position 1σ at alignment, per axis.

params.label: Velocity prior
params.note: Velocity 1σ at alignment, per axis.

params.label: Attitude prior
params.note: Attitude 1σ at alignment, per axis.
params.source: eskf.hpp:45 12 mg / g = 0.012 rad of tilt, 1.98 times that on the tilt-compensated heading

params.label: Accel bias prior
params.note: Accelerometer bias 1σ at alignment, per axis.
params.source: eskf.hpp:46 LSM6DSV typical zero-g level, 12 mg (p.10 Table 2)

kinds.label: Mahony
kinds.summary: Nonlinear complementary filter on SO(3) (Mahony, Hamel & Pflimlin 2008) with a PI gyro-bias term; position and velocity from the translation blend.

params.label: Proportional gain kP
params.note: Rate at which the attitude is pulled toward the gravity direction and the magnetometer heading.
params.source: mahony.hpp:20 mahony block default (tuned in the lab on quad-square)

params.label: Integral gain kI (gyro bias)
params.note: Integrates the correction into the gyro-bias estimate.
params.source: mahony.hpp:21 mahony block default (tuned in the lab on quad-square)

params.label: Accelerometer gate
params.note: Tilt correction only while | |a_m| - g | is below this.

params.label: GNSS position gain
params.note: Crossover of the position blend toward the GNSS fix.
params.source: complementary.hpp:19 translationBlend (complementary block default, tuned in the lab on quad-square)

params.label: GNSS velocity gain
params.note: Crossover of the velocity blend toward the GNSS velocity.
params.source: complementary.hpp:20 translationBlend (complementary block default, tuned in the lab on quad-square)

params.label: Barometer gain
params.note: Crossover of the height blend toward the barometer.
params.source: complementary.hpp:21 translationBlend (complementary block default, tuned in the lab on quad-square)

kinds.label: Complementary
kinds.summary: Integrated gyro pulled toward the accelerometer's gravity direction and the magnetometer heading; position and velocity from the translation blend. No gyro-bias estimate.

params.label: Tilt correction gain
params.note: Rate at which the attitude is pulled toward the gravity direction.

params.label: Accelerometer gate
params.note: Tilt correction only while | |a_m| - g | is below this.

params.label: Heading correction gain
params.note: Rate at which the heading is pulled toward the magnetometer.

params.label: GNSS position gain
params.note: Crossover of the position blend toward the GNSS fix.
params.source: complementary.hpp:19 translationBlend (complementary block default, tuned in the lab on quad-square)

params.label: GNSS velocity gain
params.note: Crossover of the velocity blend toward the GNSS velocity.
params.source: complementary.hpp:20 translationBlend (complementary block default, tuned in the lab on quad-square)

params.label: Barometer gain
params.note: Crossover of the height blend toward the barometer.
params.source: complementary.hpp:21 translationBlend (complementary block default, tuned in the lab on quad-square)

kinds.label: Passthrough
kinds.summary: The mission reference reaches the controller unchanged.

kinds.label: Apogee predictor
kinds.summary: While the mission flags the coast it rolls a point-mass model of the rocket from the estimated altitude and vertical speed to apogee with the brake closed, every 20 ms, and passes the prediction and the target apogee to the controller.

params.label: Prediction step
params.note: Integration step of the rollout; coarser is cheaper and less accurate.

params.label: Drag coefficient (model)
params.note: Axial drag coefficient on the reference area, brake closed.

params.label: Reference area (model)
params.note: Area the drag coefficient refers to (the body cross-section).

params.label: Brake drag area (model)
params.note: C_D A the brake adds at full deployment.

params.label: Coast mass (model)
params.note: Dry mass: the motor has burnt out during the coast.

params.label: Target apogee
params.note: Apogee above the launch point the brake aims for.

kinds.label: Trajectory
kinds.summary: Jerk-limited position smoothing along the mission's waypoints (PX4 PositionSmoothing): the reference moves toward the target at the cruise speed within the velocity, acceleration and jerk limits, corners into the next waypoint inside the acceptance radius, waits while the vehicle falls behind by more than the tracking error limits, and turns the nose along the path when the mission leaves the heading free. Not implemented yet: selected, it flies as passthrough.

params.label: Cruise speed
params.note: Horizontal speed along a mission leg when the mission names none.

params.label: Max horizontal speed
params.note: Horizontal speed the trajectory never exceeds, whatever the mission asks.

params.label: Max climb speed
params.note: Vertical speed up the trajectory never exceeds.

params.label: Max descent speed
params.note: Vertical speed down the trajectory never exceeds.

params.label: Max horizontal acceleration
params.note: Horizontal acceleration of the trajectory.

params.label: Max upward acceleration
params.note: Upward acceleration of the trajectory.

params.label: Max downward acceleration
params.note: Downward acceleration of the trajectory.

params.label: Max jerk
params.note: Rate of change of the trajectory's acceleration.

params.label: Max horizontal lag
params.note: Horizontal distance the vehicle may fall behind the trajectory before the trajectory slows to wait for it.

params.label: Max vertical lag
params.note: Vertical distance the vehicle may fall behind the trajectory before the trajectory slows to wait for it.

params.label: Max yaw rate
params.note: Rate the nose turns toward the path direction when the mission leaves the heading free.

params.label: Heading hold below
params.note: Below this horizontal path speed the heading is held.

kinds.label: Cascaded PID
kinds.summary: Position, velocity, attitude and rate loops: thrust as a fraction of full collective from the learned hover thrust, torque as a fraction of each axis' full authority.

params.label: Position gain
params.note: Velocity setpoint per metre of position error.
params.source: controller.cpp:47 w_n = sqrt(Kv Kp) = 1.18 rad/s, about 7x below the attitude loop, zeta 0.85

params.label: Velocity P gain
params.note: Acceleration per m/s of velocity error.
params.source: controller.cpp:48 Kv * kVelMax = 4 m/s^2 bounds a velocity step to 22 deg of tilt

params.label: Velocity I gain
params.note: Acceleration per metre of integrated velocity error.
params.source: controller.cpp:49 corner Ki / Kv = 0.25 rad/s; takes up what the thrust model and the rotor drag leave

params.label: Velocity integrator limit
params.note: Most horizontal acceleration the velocity integrator may add; the vertical one may reach 1 g.
params.source: controller.cpp:50; vertical: PX4@af2e7b4311 src/modules/mc_pos_control/PositionControl/PositionControl.cpp:146 constrains the vertical integral to +-CONSTANTS_ONE_G

params.label: Attitude gain roll
params.note: Roll-rate setpoint per radian of attitude error.

params.label: Attitude gain pitch
params.note: Pitch-rate setpoint per radian of attitude error.

params.label: Attitude gain yaw
params.note: Yaw-rate setpoint per radian of heading error.

params.label: Yaw deceleration
params.note: Caps the yaw-rate setpoint at sqrt(2 a |e|) so a heading step stops without overshoot.
params.source: ArduPilot@0deeede043 libraries/AC_AttitudeControl/AC_AttitudeControl.cpp:1368 the yaw attitude-error sqrt controller runs at ATC_ACCEL_Y_MAX / 2 = 135 deg/s^2 (AC_AttitudeControl.h:23) clamped to 120 deg/s^2 (AC_AttitudeControl.h:13) = 2.094 rad/s^2

params.label: Heading hold below
params.note: Below this yaw rate, with no yaw-rate reference, the heading is held.

params.label: Rate P roll
params.note: Roll torque (fraction of full roll authority) per rad/s of rate error.
params.source: ArduPilot@0deeede043 libraries/AC_AttitudeControl/AC_AttitudeControl_Multi.h:11 AC_ATC_MULTI_RATE_RP_P 0.135 (ATC_RAT_RLL_P); same units: rate PID output = torque fraction into +-0.5 motor factors (AC_AttitudeControl_Multi.cpp:476, AP_MotorsMatrix.cpp:1353-1375)

params.label: Rate P pitch
params.note: Pitch torque (fraction of full pitch authority) per rad/s of rate error.
params.source: ArduPilot@0deeede043 libraries/AC_AttitudeControl/AC_AttitudeControl_Multi.h:11 AC_ATC_MULTI_RATE_RP_P 0.135 (ATC_RAT_PIT_P); same units: rate PID output = torque fraction into +-0.5 motor factors (AC_AttitudeControl_Multi.cpp:476, AP_MotorsMatrix.cpp:1353-1375)

params.label: Rate P yaw
params.note: Yaw torque (fraction of full yaw authority) per rad/s of rate error.
params.source: ArduPilot@0deeede043 libraries/AC_AttitudeControl/AC_AttitudeControl_Multi.h:26 AC_ATC_MULTI_RATE_YAW_P 0.180 (ATC_RAT_YAW_P); same units as roll and pitch

params.label: Rate I roll
params.note: Roll torque fraction per radian of integrated rate error.

params.label: Rate I pitch
params.note: Pitch torque fraction per radian of integrated rate error.

params.label: Rate I yaw
params.note: Yaw torque fraction per radian of integrated rate error.

params.label: Rate D roll
params.note: Roll torque fraction per rad/s² of rate change.

params.label: Rate D pitch
params.note: Pitch torque fraction per rad/s² of rate change.

params.label: Rate D yaw
params.note: Yaw torque fraction per rad/s² of rate change.

params.label: Rate integrator limit roll
params.note: Most roll torque, as a fraction of full authority, the rate integrator may add.

params.label: Rate integrator limit pitch
params.note: Most pitch torque, as a fraction of full authority, the rate integrator may add.

params.label: Rate integrator limit yaw
params.note: Most yaw torque, as a fraction of full authority, the rate integrator may add.

params.label: Max roll rate
params.note: Limit of the roll-rate setpoint.

params.label: Max pitch rate
params.note: Limit of the pitch-rate setpoint.

params.label: Max yaw rate
params.note: Limit of the yaw-rate setpoint.

params.label: Max velocity setpoint
params.note: Norm limit of the velocity setpoint.

params.label: Max tilt
params.note: The thrust vector stays within this angle of vertical.

params.label: Min vertical thrust
params.note: Floor of the vertical thrust demand, in multiples of the weight.

params.label: Max total thrust
params.note: Ceiling of the total thrust, as a fraction of the four rotors' maximum.
params.source: controller.cpp:56 kThrustMax = 0.9 * 4 * kMaxRotorThrust; the rest is left for the torques

params.label: Max yaw torque
params.note: Yaw torque limit, as a fraction of full yaw authority; a yaw demand the rotors cannot carry is cut, never paid for with thrust.
params.source: ArduPilot@0deeede043 libraries/AC_AttitudeControl/AC_AttitudeControl_Multi.cpp:476 the yaw rate PID output is not capped; the mixer cuts yaw to what fits (AP_MotorsMatrix.cpp:276-329), as the allocation does

params.label: Max roll acceleration
params.note: Angular acceleration of the attitude target on roll: the target moves toward the desired attitude within it and rate_max_x, and its rate is fed forward to the rate loop.

params.label: Max pitch acceleration
params.note: Angular acceleration of the attitude target on pitch: the target moves toward the desired attitude within it and rate_max_y, and its rate is fed forward to the rate loop.

params.label: Max yaw acceleration
params.note: Angular acceleration of the attitude target on yaw: the target heading moves toward the reference within it and rate_max_z, and its rate is fed forward to the rate loop.

params.label: Input time constant
params.note: The target's acceleration reaches its limit in this time: the jerk is the acceleration limit over it, on every axis.
params.source: ArduPilot@0deeede043 libraries/AC_AttitudeControl/AC_AttitudeControl.cpp:16 AC_ATTITUDE_CONTROL_INPUT_TC_DEFAULT 0.10 s (ATC_INPUT_TC, Copter); jerk = accel_max / input_tc, AC_AttitudeControl.cpp:1128. ArduPilot's yaw uses PILOT_Y_RATE_TC instead (0: 10 ticks, AC_AttitudeControl.cpp:1120-1123)

kinds.label: Apogee PI (air brake)
kinds.summary: Brake deployment = clamp(kp e + ki int(e), 0, 1) while the mission flags the coast and the predictor's apogee is valid, e the predicted apogee with the brake closed minus the target; closed otherwise. The integral starts at zero and is limited to +-i_limit.

params.label: Proportional gain
params.note: Deployment per metre of predicted overshoot.
params.source: toolbox controller.ts:146 (PI tuned in the lab)

params.label: Integral gain
params.note: Deployment per metre-second of accumulated overshoot.
params.source: toolbox controller.ts:147 (PI tuned in the lab)

params.label: Integral limit
params.note: Bound on the accumulated overshoot.
params.source: toolbox controller.ts:148 (PI tuned in the lab)

kinds.label: Quad X
kinds.summary: Thrust and torque fractions to four rotor thrust fractions with fixed +-0.5 factors (motor order 0 FR, 1 RL, 2 FL, 3 RR): collective up to the hover thrust, then roll and pitch, then the rest of the collective, then yaw.

kinds.label: Air brake
kinds.summary: The controller's brake deployment, 0..1, in flight; every motor command zero, always.

kinds.label: Rotor speed fraction
kinds.summary: Each motor command is the rotor speed as a fraction of its maximum: spin_min + (spin_max - spin_min) times the inverse of the thrust curve (1 - e) x + e x^2 at the rotor's thrust fraction.

params.label: Thrust curve expo
params.note: e of thrust = (1 - e) x + e x^2: 1 for a rotor-speed command (thrust = k w^2).
params.source: AP_Motors_Thrust_Linearization.cpp:104-107; 1 = sqrt: the sim ESC is linear from command to rad/s for every airframe (bridge/src/gz_world.cpp:215) and the motor model's thrust is k w^2. ArduPilot's real-ESC 0.65 (AP_MotorsMulticopter.h:9, with SPIN_MIN/MAX 0.15/0.95) raises the x500's hover to 0.66 of the command range and left it 0.8 m low in hover

params.label: Spin minimum
params.note: Command at zero thrust while armed.
params.source: AP_Motors_Thrust_Linearization.cpp:104-107; 0: the sim ESC's zero rotor speed is zero thrust (bridge/src/gz_world.cpp:215); ArduPilot's real-ESC 0.15 is AP_MotorsMulticopter.h:14

params.label: Spin maximum
params.note: Command at full thrust.
params.source: AP_Motors_Thrust_Linearization.cpp:104-107; 1: the sim ESC reaches the motor model's full speed at a command of 1 (bridge/src/gz_world.cpp:215); ArduPilot's real-ESC 0.95 is AP_MotorsMulticopter.h:15

params.label: Spin when armed
params.note: Every motor command while armed on the ground (kArmed).

kinds.label: Brake servo
kinds.summary: The brake servo command is the deployment, unchanged.
